documentComment: Unpublished SDK-candidate inventory; R1 is not accepted. Preserve the original 57 runtime/SDK component records and add 523 checksum-verified host-Cargo registry lock-closure packages plus 6 Cargo/native identity records. Lock membership does not assert compilation or linkage; per-package sourceInfo distinguishes those scopes. Cargo notices/preferred-source capsule SHA-256 da23b154fd15d595329de28cbf1db650bf8b1da57679ef270c09c9d7e84dc62f includes the complete lock-matched libgit2-sys crate and 3 MPL package sources. Source evidence resolves the misleading Cargo sys:0.21.0 field as the git2 wrapper version; actual final-binary linkage/redistribution acceptance remain separate gates. Whole mixed C-SDK licences are not inferred from selected runtime-member scope.
